# frontmatter-editing

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-001 — A writer edits metadata values in place with fitting controls](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-001.md) — When a writer clicks, or presses Enter or Space on, a field name or value of the properties table in edit mode, the Studio SHALL open an editor inside that cell, one at a time, with a control that fits the field type, and leave the table inert in reading mode and in a read-only preview.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-002 — Edit each kind of metadata value with a fitting control](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-002.md) — When a writer edits a metadata value, the Studio SHALL offer a control that fits the field type: a choice list for enums, a text box, number, date and time inputs, a checkbox, an item list or a YAML text box.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-003 — Edit list fields and link lists item by item](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-003.md) — When a writer edits a list field, the Studio SHALL show one input per item that can be added, removed and reordered, and suggest known Markdown file names for filename-stem link lists.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-004 — Save, cancel and follow metadata edits](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-004.md) — When a writer commits or cancels a metadata edit, the Studio SHALL save only a changed value, show the progress and any refusal in the editor, keep the properties table in place, and leave the document undoable.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-005 — A writer adds, renames and removes metadata fields](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-005.md) — When a writer renames a field by clicking its name in edit mode, or chooses Add field or Remove field from a field editor, the Studio SHALL rename the key in place, add a schema field or a custom key at the place its row appears, or delete exactly that field, refusing an empty, padded or already used name and the removal of a required field.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-006 — Add a metadata field](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-006.md) — When a writer chooses Add field from a field editor, the Studio SHALL add a schema field or a custom key at the place its row appears and open its editor.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-007 — Remove a metadata field](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-007.md) — When a writer chooses Remove field from a field editor, the Studio SHALL delete exactly that field and refuse to remove a field the schema requires.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-008 — Metadata edits keep the source intact, follow the schema and never lose text](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-008.md) — When a writer edits a metadata field, the Studio SHALL change only the lines of that field, refuse with a reason any edit whose result would not parse, would alter other keys, does not match the schema, targets a stale preview or runs in an untrusted workspace, and save typed text instead of dropping it when the writer navigates away.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-009 — Refuse metadata edits that break the schema or the document state](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-009.md) — When a metadata edit does not match the schema, targets a stale preview or runs in an untrusted workspace, the Studio SHALL refuse it with a reason and leave the document unchanged.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-010 — Keep typed metadata text when leaving the editor](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-010.md) — When a writer navigates away or the preview needs to flush an open field editor, the Studio SHALL save the typed text as is instead of dropping it, and warn if it is refused.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-011 — Keep metadata editing separate from other editing](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-FMEDIT-011.md) — While a field editor is open, the Studio SHALL block refresh, checkbox toggles and block selection and block moves, and keep the properties table out of block selection, movement and navigation.

<!-- okfreq:index:end -->
